universe: Occupied ACS 1-year PUMS households (TYPEHUGQ==1, NP>0, WGTP>0). Not the R2.4 geography/bedroom/infant frame. Diagnostic cost is the frozen R2.4 three-component monthly mean $2,894.90805340822. This is NOT the published 18.9918% HESI share.

simulated_forecast_date.ACS_T_to_Tplus1: 31 January of year T+2. Calendar-year T+1 CES/BEA monthly observations through December T+1 are treated as available. ACS T+1 PUMS is treated as unavailable. ALFRED vintages at that date are preferred; if only current FRED/BLS vintages exist, that is a documented hindsight-revision limitation, not a silent update.
simulated_forecast_date.forbidden: Do not use ACS T+1 microdata to fit factors. Do not use series observations dated after December T+1 for the T→T+1 backtest.

models.M1_freeze: All reconstructed sources held at origin-year amounts (factor=1).
models.M2_uniform_cpi: DIAGNOSTIC CONTROL ONLY. Multiply origin-year hincp_adj by CPI-U annual-average T+1/T. Forbidden for production even if it wins.
models.M3_aggregate_wage: Apply CES total-private AHE annual-average T+1/T only to households with WAGP>0, and only to the WAGP component. Other sources frozen. Zero-wage households get no wage factor.
models.M4_source_specific: WAGP>0: CES AWE annual-average T+1/T (rate×hours, not AHE alone). WAGP<=0: freeze WAGP. SEMP>=0: BEA proprietors income T+1/T. SEMP<0: freeze. SSP/SSIP: January COLA of T+1. INTP>=0: BEA personal interest+dividends T+1/T. INTP<0: freeze. RETP, PAP, OIP, residual: freeze. Employment counts frozen (no extensive-margin wage creation).

pass_all_required_for_GO.rule: Hashed machine-readable CES AHE, CES AWE or hours, CES private employment, ECI (or documented ECI failure), BEA proprietors, BEA interest+dividends, CPI-U. HTML stubs and HTTP 403 bodies are not series.
For BOTH 2022→2023 and 2023→2024, |M4 occupied weighted mean HINCP percent error| <= 0.015
For BOTH years, |M4 diagnostic share-below error in probability points| <= 0.005
For BOTH years, |M4 WAGP percent error| <= 0.020
For BOTH years, |M4 HINCP percent error| < |M1 HINCP percent error|
M2 is never the production choice, regardless of score.
ACS 80-SDR sampling SE on origin-year projected share (factors fixed) is reported separately from share error vs T+1 actual. Do not add them.
